definitions.explanation: The sun and all the celestial bodies that orbit it, including the eight planets, their moons, asteroids, and comets.

examples.japanese: {太陽系|たいようけい}には{八|はち}つの{惑星|わくせい}がある。
examples.english: There are eight planets in the solar system.

examples.japanese: {探査機|たんさき}が{太陽系|たいようけい}の{外|そと}へ{向|む}かっている。
examples.english: The space probe is heading beyond the solar system.

examples.japanese: {太陽系|たいようけい}が{誕生|たんじょう}したのは{約|やく}46{億年前|おくねんまえ}だと{考|かんが}えられている。
examples.english: It is believed that the solar system was born approximately 4.6 billion years ago.

notes:
{太陽系|たいようけい} is the solar system — our sun and all the celestial bodies that orbit it.

WORD FORMATION:
{太陽|たいよう} (sun) + {系|けい} (system). The {系|けい} suffix creates system-related compounds:
- {銀河系|ぎんがけい}: the galaxy (Milky Way)
- {生態系|せいたいけい}: ecosystem

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {太陽系|たいようけい}の{惑星|わくせい}: planets of the solar system
- {太陽系|たいようけい}の{外|そと}: outside the solar system
- {太陽系|たいようけい}{外|がい}{惑星|わくせい}: exoplanet
- {太陽系|たいようけい}の{起源|きげん}: origin of the solar system

THE EIGHT PLANETS:
{水星|すいせい}、{金星|きんせい}、{地球|ちきゅう}、{火星|かせい}、{木星|もくせい}、{土星|どせい}、{天王星|てんのうせい}、{海王星|かいおうせい}
